Free one-on-one tech help available Aug. 24-25

August 20, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
0:00 / 0:46
Instaread

Community members looking to sharpen their digital skills or navigate online applications can access free, personalized assistance at the Prior Lake Library later this month.

The library will host Public Computer Aide sessions on Monday, Aug. 24, and Tuesday, Aug. 25. Trained volunteers will work one-on-one with adult patrons needing help with basic computer operations, internet navigation or specific software provided through the Scott County Library system.

Sessions are scheduled for Monday, Aug. 24, from 10 a.m. to noon, followed by two offerings on Tuesday, Aug. 25, from 1 to 3 p.m. and 3 to 6 p.m.

The drop-in service is designed to support users of all skill levels with things like learning foundational computer skills, managing digital files and seeking guidance on library database tools.
